long_biography.plain_text:
Palatchi inherited a Barcelona shop from his parents and used it to launch Pronovias in 1964. He shifted bridalwear toward ready-to-wear production, combining design, manufacturing, marketing and international distribution. The business grew from its local lace-and-embroidery roots into a wedding-dress group serving customers through company stores and thousands of independent retailers.

In 2017, Palatchi sold control of Pronovias to BC Partners after more than five decades at its helm. He retained a minority investment and an advisory board role during the transition. The transaction marked the culmination of a family-business expansion that had turned a local retail base into a global fashion platform and made Pronovias one of the largest wedding-dress companies.
